data_quality.notes: Full name Liberato Gianpaolo Cacace, born 27 Sep 2000 in Wellington, New Zealand. A Stuff.co.nz headline describes him returning to Wellington 'a Serie A star', indicating an intervening move to Italian football (Serie A) not fully detailed in the snippets -> not itemized as a specific club/date. Now at Wrexham (EFL Championship, Wales/England) per the club's own site. Captained the All Whites to the 2024 OFC Nations Cup title and was nominated for the FIFA Best Men's 11.
